title: 云路复材亮相2026国际先进复合材料技术展览会 (SAMPE)
titleEn: Yunlu Composites Debuts at 2026 International Advanced Composite Materials Technology Exhibition (SAMPE)

content:
作为复合材料行业顶级盛会，SAMPE 先进复合材料技术展览会如期举行。云路复材携最新研制的三维编织曲面织造装备参展，向全球客商展示了三维编织的数字化孪生仿真与高精度张力控制系统，吸引了大量航天航空制造代表驻足交流。

在本次展览会上，云路复材展示的新一代三维环形织造机首次实现了异形芯模（Mandrels）的精确在线随动织造。该设备不仅具备超多纱线高频张力微调结构，还整合了实时激光厚度扫描标定单元。这一技术在民用航空主承力构件、特种压力容器缠绕等领域有着广阔的产业化前景。参会期间，公司展台共接待了来自国内外数十家知名科研院所与重点企业的技术团队，达成了初步的合作意向协议。
contentEn:
As the premier event in the composite materials industry, the SAMPE Advanced Composite Materials Technology Exhibition was held as scheduled. Yunlu Composites exhibited its latest 3D braiding curved surface weaving equipment, showcasing digital twin simulation and high-precision tension control systems to global customers, attracting numerous aerospace manufacturing representatives.

At this exhibition, Yunlu Composites' next-generation 3D annular braiding machine achieved precise online follow-up braiding of profiled mandrels for the first time. The equipment features ultra-multi-yarn high-frequency tension fine-tuning structures and integrates real-time laser thickness scanning calibration units. This technology has broad industrialization prospects in civil aviation primary load-bearing components and specialty pressure vessel winding. During the event, the company's booth received technical teams from dozens of renowned domestic and international research institutes and key enterprises, reaching preliminary cooperation intention agreements.
